name: h.assign.arg
script:
state n = 0
handler inc(x: number) { n = n + x }

name: h.if.then
h.if.else
h.elseif
h.path.list
script:
state items = [{title: "a", done: false}, {title: "b", done: false}]
handler toggle(i: number) { items[i].done = !(items[i].done ?? false) }

name: h.path.record
script:
state user = {name: "A", meta: {age: 1}}
handler bump() { user.meta.age = user.meta.age + 1 }

name: h.path.oob
script:
state items = [{done: false}]
handler go() { items[5].done = true }

name: h.run.nested
h.run.args
h.animate.body
script:

name: h.timeline.effects
h.computed.read
h.computed.fresh
script:
state a = 1
let b = a * 2
state seen = 0
handler go() {
  a = 5
  seen = b
}

name: h.misc.effects
script:
data me = demo.profile()
handler go() {
  refresh(me)
  host("openProfile", {id: 5})
  open("https://example.com/" + str(7))
  present("sheet.x", {a: 1})
  dismiss()
  back()
}

name: h.path.alias
script:
state items = [{done: false}]
state snap = true
handler go() {
  let before = items
  items[0].done = true
  snap = before[0].done ?? true
}
